components.name: Circuit playback control
components.description: Replay control with a copper keyboard focus outline; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

narrative.overview:
The documentation and Sales Strategy Library share a quiet reading surface: cool gray paper, dark text, copper links, thin dividers and white working panels. The existing IBM Plex Sans family carries both explanatory prose and compact evidence labels.

This record covers those public reading surfaces, the completed library extension and the shared deal circuit embedded in the library and homepage. It does not define the complete homepage, other assistant demonstrations, dashboard or a new brand. The library adds evidence states and selectable scenarios within the incumbent documentation language. The circuit keeps the same paper, copper and IBM Plex Sans identity while showing how context becomes a next move.
keyCharacteristics: Flat sections divided by fine rules.
Copper links and visible keyboard focus.
Evidence labels retain their words as well as color.
Persistent arrows and finite, replayable circuit motion.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the cool paper background for reading and white for contained working material.

rules.name: The Named State Rule
rules.body: Evidence colors always accompany a written state; color alone does not carry the meaning.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use medium-weight headings, close tracking and generous prose line height rather than heavy display type.

rules.name: The Stacked Evidence Rule
rules.body: The library evidence and strategy columns become a single reading sequence on small screens.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Documentation and library sections use dividers and surface color rather than shadows.

rules.name: The Persistent Circuit Rule
rules.body: Keep every stage, its core text and all six arrows visible independently of playback; source context expands separately.

rules.name: The Finite Signal Rule
rules.body: Circuit motion is a finite, replayable explanation; reduced motion presents the complete static circuit.

dos: Do reuse the existing font, reading colors and copper focus treatment.
Do keep evidence labels visible beside their state colors.
Do preserve a single reading sequence when columns stack.
Do use white panels for prompts and the next move.
Do retain the complete circuit when playback stops or reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't apply this scoped record as a complete homepage design system.
Don't replace textual evidence states with color alone.
Don't hide circuit content behind playback or treat animation as a new proof.
Don't introduce shadow elevation into these reading surfaces without a new design decision.
